playbookOutputs: CIPC CoR39 confirmation reflecting the amended director details
playbookCommonFailures: The change requested is actually an appointment or resignation, which needs the Add / Remove Director service and its documents
Certified ID older than 3 months for the director whose details change
New residential address supplied without a proof of address in the director's name
Company has outstanding annual returns and CIPC blocks the CoR39

informationToProvide.label: Company registration number (CIPC CoR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3, CK1, CK2 or MOI document showing company registration number, registered enterprise name and current directors as registered.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID copies for all directors (new and existing, if applicable)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of residential address for all directors (not older than 3 months)
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Is a residential or postal address being changed?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, rates account, lease or bank statement dated within 3 months in the director's own name, showing the NEW address.

informationToProvide.label: Details of the specific changes required (e.g., new director details, resignation date, updated address)
informationToProvide.helpText: Tell us exactly what must change for which director: name, ID number, address, contact details, designation.

informationToProvide.label: Director Current & New Email Address and Cellphone Number (for CIPC CoR 39 OTP Verification)
informationToProvide.helpText: CIPC sends verification OTPs via both SMS and Email when amending director contact or personal particulars. Provide both current and updated email/cellphone details.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect the requested changes and supporting documents
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, a clear list of changes per director, and a certified ID (and proof of address where an address changes) received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Get a precise list: which director, which field, old value, new value. If the change is adding or removing a director, tell the client plainly that this service covers detail changes only and propose Add Director / Remove Director instead. Name changes (e.g. after marriage) need the ID reflecting the new name. Turnaround 1-2 working days; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against the register
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Uploads pass; each change is supported by a document; company status 'In Business'
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Compare the current CIPC register (directors tab on e-Services) with the requested changes so you know exactly which fields differ. Every ID number / name / date-of-birth change must match the certified ID; every address change must match the proof of address. Outstanding annual returns block the transaction — propose Annual Returns first if needed.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft CoR39 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet with old value / new value per field per director, plus attachment list
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: One row per changed field: director, field, value currently on CIPC, new value, supporting document. Anything without a supporting document is flagged, not filed.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: File CoR39 director amendment on CIPC e-Services
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Amendment staged with only the changed fields edited; Kevin has submitted; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services > Transact > Director Amendments (CoR39). Edit the existing director record — do not delete and re-add, which creates a resignation and a new appointment. Upload the certified ID and proof of address as supporting documents. ⚠ verify: whether CIPC currently requires a signed CoR39 upload for detail-only amendments. Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to process the amendment
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR39 confirmation received and the register reflects the change
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check tracking status before following up. On rejection quote the reason to Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CoR39 confirmation and updated CoR14.3
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Confirmation and re-downloaded CoR14.3 posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Remind the client to update the same details with SARS and the bank if they were changed.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
